flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:3000 then Add 3 shirts to the cart.
Verify the cart badge shows exactly 3.
Then open the cart and verify the charged total matches the sum of the items.

cart_badge_count_check.query: the cart item count displayed in the cart link badge in the header

charged_total_matches_items_sum.query: whether the total amount in the cart summary equals the sum of the line totals in the cart table
charged_total_matches_items_sum.condition: the charged total matches the sum of the items.
charged_total_matches_items_sum.human_description: Comparing the cart total with the sum of item line totals
charged_total_matches_items_sum.code_js: (() => { const table = el(4).querySelector('table'); const sum = Array.from(table.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')).reduce((total, row) => total + Number(row.cells[3].innerText.replace(/[^0-9.-]/g, '')), 0); const totalText = Array.from(el(4).querySelectorAll('p')).map(p => p.innerText.trim()).find(text => text.startsWith('Total:')); const charged = Number((totalText || '').replace(/[^0-9.-]/g, '')); return charged === sum; })()
